chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Kāhilī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
If blood or some discharge comes out from the nostril of the deceased after he has been given ghusl, and it reaches the turban and the shroud, that part is to be cut away from it.

key_terms.الْعِمَامَةَ: the turban cloth used in shrouding
key_terms.قُرِضَ: was cut away or trimmed off

ai.seo_question: What should be done if blood comes out of a deceased person after ghusl and stains the shroud?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the shrouding of the deceased after ghusl. If blood or another substance exits from the deceased and soils the turban or shroud, the affected portion is to be cut away.
